scope: The airport-facing delta museum hall at Rockcliffe, including the mapped public addition and auditorium and the separate curved reserve hangar. Include the abutting lower service hangar, with airfield vehicles and aircraft displays outside the model scope.

references.caption: Canada Aviation Museum, from across the Rockcliffe airport.
references.alt: Canada Aviation Museum, from across the Rockcliffe airport.

originalReview.notes: Airfield ground view establishes the pale metal cladding, long low horizontal bays and repeating raked dark glazing along the main runway-side volume. It predates the lobby extension.

references.caption: I took this aerial photo of the en:Canada Aviation Museum on June 5th, 2005.
references.alt: I took this aerial photo of the en:Canada Aviation Museum on June 5th, 2005.

originalReview.notes: Airside aerial view shows the delta main exhibit hall, broad pale roof, runway edge and the separate pale reserve hangar. Exterior evidence predates the 2010 public lobby extension.

references.caption: A BeaverTails food truck at the Canada Aviation and Space Museum in Ottawa, Ontario, during a solar eclipse viewing event there on April 8, 2024.
references.alt: A BeaverTails food truck at the Canada Aviation and Space Museum in Ottawa, Ontario, during a solar eclipse viewing event there on April 8, 2024.

originalReview.notes: 2024 view records cladding color, pale soffit, black panel joins and the museum apron. The vehicle and people obscure most of the front and supply no basis for the entrance layout.

quallaSearch.notes: Inspected three exact Qualla originals after comparing the local files to native Commons hashes and creator dedications. The 2005 and 2006 releases support the original massing and airside facades. The 2024 CC0 view supports selected current exterior finishes. The existing map and primary written project records fix the later visitor addition.
